title: Page 2
content_zh:
保贝儿听出壮汉快捺不住脾气，担心他火山爆发会伤及老婆婆，她只好示意地陪先生，他们一人一边拉开老婆婆紧握住壮汉的双手，好让他脱身，早点脱离苦海。
老婆婆看似瘦小，没想到力气颇大，更令人惊愕的是，老婆婆无视两人的拉扯，宛若遇到久别重逢的情人，眼里只有壮汉，彷佛有一箩筐的话要对他说。
壮汉先生已濒临不耐烦的极限，在他们拉住老婆婆的手之际，他粗壮的手臂用力一抽——
终于，他重获自由了。
但是……
糟！他的手挥到了一个陶钵，那是老板向一位知名陶艺大师商借来摆设展览的非卖品，若是摔破了，赔钱事小，恐怕日后再也借不到大师的作品。
一个念头倏地闪过她脑里——就算摔死她也要护住那个陶钵！
放开老婆婆的手，保贝儿飞快冲向从半空中垂直降落的陶钵，以扑接的方式成功接住无价之宝，而她整个人也趴的一声，重重的狠摔在地，痛得她叫不出声。
她还来不及喘气，旋即砰的一声，一只大熊活生生地跌躺在她背上，把她压得更像被牛车碾过的肉饼。
终于，她放声大叫，「啊——」
就算想帮她把痛呼喊出口，也不需要用到如此凶残的方法吧！她的脊椎恐怕被大熊压断了好几根——
唯一值得庆幸的是，她两手高捧着的陶钵，安然无恙，阿弥陀佛。
三个月后，台湾。
艺廊老板找到一位接替她工作的日本学生后，保贝儿终于回到台湾和母亲相聚，亲人团圆本该是天大的喜事，但她脸上却不见一丝笑容，反倒布满哀伤。
「保俊，你醒醒，妈在叫你，你听到没？」
医院的病房里，她的双胞胎哥哥保俊躺在床上一动也不动，让她的母亲林湘云伤心欲绝。
保贝儿看着和自己相似脸孔的哥哥，心中万分感慨。
在他们很小的时候，父母离异，哥哥归父亲，她则归母亲，她和母亲相依为命，虽然日子过得很清苦，但她自觉比哥哥幸福，因为她拥有母亲完整的疼爱。
反观父亲，离婚后不久便再婚，他不疼哥哥，也不准母亲去看哥哥，母亲总是趁学校午休时间偷偷去探望哥哥，直到上了大学，哥哥有自主能力，他们一家三口才「正大光明」见面，虽然父亲很生气，但也拿哥哥没辙。
两年前，哥哥的继母掏空父亲公司的钱，卷款带着女儿和别的男人私奔，但令父亲更为震撼的是，他和第二任妻子所生的女儿竟不是他的亲生骨肉，在双重打击之下，父亲病倒了，不到一年的时间，便撒手人寰。

原本在父亲的公司担任总经理的哥哥，在公司倒闭后，毅然决定和母亲一起开间早餐店，完成二十多年来一直在早餐店打工的母亲的梦想。哥哥不怕吃苦，也放得下身段，他说，他要弥补母亲二十多年来没有儿子陪在身边的遗憾。
两行热泪滚下，保贝儿吸了吸鼻，掩嘴痛哭，哥哥贴心的话言犹在耳，才一年的光景，上帝就要从母亲身边夺走他？夺走一个想对母亲尽孝的好儿子？
她还记得三个月前，她毕业时，哥哥和母亲特地飞到意大利去看她，哥哥还说要重新规画早餐店里的一面墙，最上端摆设一些比较特殊的陶艺作品，下面则规画一百格，每一格都摆放各有特色的杯子，来店里用早餐的客人，不管是要喝豆浆、奶茶、咖啡，都可以自由选用自己喜欢的杯子。
当时她还对哥哥抱怨说，她才刚毕业，他就迫不及待给她出难题，但抱怨归抱怨，她非常赞同哥哥的提议，能为早餐店尽一份心力，她可是非常乐意。
三个月来，一百个杯子的设计图她已经画好，就等着回台湾再给哥哥过目，如果哥哥觉得满意，她就开始动工。
可是现在……
「保俊，你有没有听到妈在叫你？呜……」
「妈……」抱住母亲，保贝儿想劝母亲别哭，自己却已哭成泪人儿。
「贝儿……你哥哥他……会不会再也醒不过来？」林湘云揪着心问女儿。
「不……不会的，妈……哥会醒来的，他一定会醒来的。」看着病床上那张过于苍白的脸孔，保贝儿忍不住又哭了起来。
就在半个月前，如同往常一样，清晨四点哥哥就出门准备早餐店的材料，不知被谁开车撞及，倒在家门前，开车者不但肇事逃逸，最可恶的是，依警方研判，哥哥不但被撞倒，还被倒车再碾一次。
她怎么也不敢想象那画面，怎会有人如此丧尽天良
哥哥以前在父亲公司和谁有过恩怨，她和母亲皆不知，警方说，也不一定是和谁有恩怨，或许是单纯的酒驾撞人事件，有些人担心被害人醒来指认，索性一不做、二不休，再撞被害者一次，非要置被害人于死地不可。
哥哥虽然没死，但却成了植物人，如今躺在病床上动也不动。
虽然警方说一定会全力追查肇事者，但他们住家附近路口没有监视器，凌晨四点大家都还在睡梦中，自然缺乏目击者，一丝线索都没有，如何查起？
眼下，她只能祈祷上帝让哥哥快点醒来，让他们一家三口能够快快乐乐的生活在一起。
「保俊……保俊……」
「妈，不要伤心，哥这么孝顺，上帝一定会给他一个重生的机会，我相信一定会有奇迹发生，一定会有的！」
「贝儿——」
「妈——」

母女俩相拥哭泣，共同希望奇迹早日降临。
天信集团，总裁办公室。
「总裁，航海造船的副总裁方才打电话来说，今天下午原本要和你谈建造货柜船一事，但他临时有事，可否改成明天下午？」
「告诉他，明天下午我没空。」
「呃，总裁，明天下午你只安排拜访诚信集团的老总裁，其它时间——」
「我没空！」坐在总裁专属座椅上的人，怒吼打断秘书小姐的话，一脸不爽。
「……」被第二任代理总裁一瞪，纤弱的秘书小姐吓得倒退三步。「是……是。」
眉头一皱，「明天下午我还要到机场一趟，这么重要的事，你怎会不知道？」这些女人到底在干么？
「嗯？啊，对，我有记下，可是一时忘了……对不起，总裁，对不起……」秘书小姐急得快哭了。
拜托！不会又想哭了吧？他真受不了这些柔弱的女人。
「好了，打电话告诉航海造船的副总裁，我只给他今天下午原先约定的时间，如果他妈的不想来，我没有其它时间再见他！」
第1章(2)
吓！吓！吓！连三吓！
秘书小姐惊愣住。总裁……不，掌三少居然爆粗话他果然是个粗人，呜，她好怕他，他那么高壮，脾气那么暴躁，她真担心他一生气，会赏她一拳。
人家正牌总裁掌大少虽然威严，可他从未爆粗话，做事有条有理，不会乱发脾气；之前的代理总裁掌二少更别说了，他幽默风趣，虽爱花言巧语，谈吐却不俗，整个人赏心悦目到了极点。
可他掌三少，虽然顶着一张超性格的俊脸，但他高壮的外表、火爆的脾气，还有不知从哪个坏朋友那边染上的爆粗话恶习……真是一整个令人不敢恭维。
「你还有什么事？」
「没……没有。」吓到魂都飞了，她哪还记得有什么事？
「没有还不快……」滚？不行，这个字一出口，包准吓哭她，他可不想总裁办公室豪雨成灾。「去做你的事。」
content_en:
Bao Beier heard that the strong man could not hold back his temper and was worried that his volcanic eruption would hurt the old woman, so she had no choice but to accompany her husband. They both pulled away the old woman and held the strong man's hands tightly, so that he could escape and escape from the sea of ​​suffering as soon as possible.
The old woman seemed thin, but she didn't expect to be very strong. What was even more shocking was that the old woman ignored the two people's pull, as if meeting a lover reunited after a long separation, only seeing the strong man, as if she had a lot of things to say to him.
The strong man was on the verge of reaching the limit of his impatience. When they held the old woman's hand, his thick arm twitched hard——
Finally, he was free.
But...
Oops! His hand waved to a pottery bowl, which was a not-for-sale item that the boss borrowed from a well-known pottery master for display in the exhibition. If it broke, it would be a small matter of losing money, and I'm afraid he would never be able to borrow the master's work again in the future.
A thought flashed through her mind - even if she fell to death, she would still protect the pottery bowl!
Letting go of the old woman's hand, Bao Beier quickly rushed towards Tao Bo, who had plummeted from mid-air, and successfully caught the priceless treasure with a pounce. At the same time, she fell to the ground with a thump, and she fell to the ground so hard that she couldn't scream in pain.
Before she could take a breath, there was a loud bang, and a big bear fell alive on her back, crushing her like a meat pie that had been run over by a bullock cart.
Finally, she shouted loudly, "Ah——"
Even if you want to help her express her pain, there is no need to use such cruel methods! I'm afraid several of her spines were broken by the bear——
The only thing she was thankful for was that the pottery bowl she held high in both hands was safe and sound, Amitabha.
Three months later, Taiwan.
After the gallery owner found a Japanese student to take over her job, Belle finally returned to Taiwan to reunite with her mother. The reunion of her family should have been a great joy, but instead of a smile on her face, she was filled with sadness.
"Baojun, wake up, mom is calling you, do you hear it?"
In the hospital ward, her twin brother Baojun lay motionless on the bed, which made her mother Lin Xiangyun heartbroken.
Bao Beier looked at her brother, who had a face similar to hers, and was filled with emotion.
When they were very young, their parents divorced. Her brother belonged to her father, while she belonged to her mother. She and her mother depended on each other. Although their lives were very difficult, she felt happier than her brother because she had the complete love of her mother.
On the other hand, my father remarried soon after the divorce. He did not love his brother and did not allow his mother to visit him. My mother always used the school lunch break to secretly visit her brother. It was not until college and my brother became independent that the three of them met openly. Although my father was very angry, he had nothing to do with his brother.
Two years ago, my brother's stepmother emptied the money from his father's company and ran off with her daughter to run away with another man. But what shocked his father even more was that the daughter he had with his second wife was not his biological flesh and blood. Under a double blow, his father fell ill and passed away in less than a year.
My brother, who was originally the general manager of his father's company, decided to open a breakfast shop with his mother after the company closed down, fulfilling the dream of her mother, who had been working in a breakfast shop for more than 20 years. The elder brother is not afraid of hardship, and he is also relaxed about his figure. He said that he wanted to make up for the regret that his mother had not had a son by her side for more than 20 years.
Two lines of hot tears rolled down. Bao Beier sniffed, covered her mouth and cried bitterly. Her brother's thoughtful words still rang in her ears. After only one year, God was going to take him away from her mother? Take away a good son who wants to be filial to his mother?
She still remembers that three months ago, when she graduated, her brother and mother flew to Italy to see her. Her brother also said that he would redecorate a wall in the breakfast shop. Some special pottery works would be displayed at the top, and a hundred grids would be planned below. Each grid would be filled with unique cups. Guests who came to the shop for breakfast could drink soy milk, milk tea, or coffee.Feel free to choose the cup you like.
At that time, she complained to her brother that she had just graduated and he couldn't wait to give her problems. But complaints were complaints. She very much agreed with her brother's proposal and was very happy to contribute to the breakfast restaurant.
In the past three months, she has drawn the design drawings of a hundred cups, and she is waiting to show it to her brother when she returns to Taiwan. If he is satisfied, she will start construction.
But now...
"Baojun, did you hear mom calling you? Ugh..."
"Mom..." Bao Beier hugged her mother and tried to persuade her not to cry, but she was already reduced to tears.
"Belle...will your brother...will never wake up again?" Lin Xiangyun asked his daughter with heartache.
"No... no, Mom... Brother will wake up, he will definitely wake up." Looking at the too pale face on the hospital bed, Bao Beier couldn't help crying again.
Just half a month ago, as usual, my brother went out to prepare ingredients for a breakfast shop at four o'clock in the morning. He was hit by someone's car and fell in front of his house. The driver not only hit and run, but the most disgusting thing is, according to the police's judgment, not only was he knocked down, he was also reversed and ran over again.
She never dared to imagine that scene. How could someone be so heartless?
Neither she nor her mother knew who her brother had a grudge with in the past in her father's company. The police said that it was not necessarily with whom. It might have been a simple drunk driving incident. Some people were worried that the victim would wake up and identify him, so they simply did not do anything and hit the victim again, otherwise the victim would be killed.
Although my brother is not dead, he has become a vegetative state and is now lying motionless on the hospital bed.
Although the police said they would do their best to track down the perpetrators, there were no surveillance cameras at the intersection near their home. Everyone was still asleep at four in the morning. Naturally, there were no witnesses and no clues. How could they investigate?
At the moment, she can only pray to God that her brother will wake up soon so that the three of them can live happily together.
"Baojun... Baojun..."
"Mom, don't be sad. If my brother is so filial, God will definitely give him a chance to be reborn. I believe a miracle will happen. It will definitely happen!"
"Belle——"
"Mom——"
The mother and daughter hugged each other and cried, hoping that a miracle would come soon.
Tianxin Group, President’s Office.
"President, the vice president of Navigation and Shipbuilding just called and said that he was originally going to talk to you about building a container ship this afternoon, but he is temporarily busy. Can it be changed to tomorrow afternoon?"
"Tell him I'm not free tomorrow afternoon."
"Uh, CEO, tomorrow afternoon you will only arrange to visit the old president of Integrity Group. The rest of the time -"
"I'm not free!" The person sitting in the president's exclusive chair roared and interrupted the secretary, looking unhappy.
"..." The frail secretary took three steps back in fright when the second acting president glared at her. "Yes...yes."
He frowned and said, "I have to go to the airport tomorrow afternoon. How could you not know about such an important thing?" What on earth are these women doing?
"Huh? Ah, yes, I wrote it down, but I forgot for a moment... I'm sorry, CEO, I'm sorry..." The secretary was so anxious that she almost cried.
Please! Don't you want to cry again? He really couldn't stand these weak women.
"Okay, call and tell the vice president of Navigation and Shipbuilding that I will only give him the originally agreed time this afternoon. If he doesn't want to come, I won't have any other time to see him!"
Chapter 1(2)
Scared! scare! scare! Three times in a row!
The secretary was stunned. CEO... no, Third Young Master Zhang actually said something rude. He was indeed a rough man. Wow, she was so afraid of him. He was so tall and strong and had such a bad temper. She was really worried that he would punch her when he was angry.
Although the official CEO, the Young Master Zhang, is majestic, he never uses foul language, works in an orderly manner, and does not lose his temper; let alone the former acting president, the Second Young Master Zhang,He is humorous, and although he loves to talk, his conversation is good, and the whole person is extremely pleasing to the eye.
But he is the Third Young Master. Although he has a super handsome face, his tall appearance, fiery temper, and the bad habit of swearing he picked up from some bad friend... are really unflattering.
"What else do you want?"
"No...no." She was so frightened that she lost her mind. How could she remember anything?
"Why don't you hurry up..." Get out? No, as soon as the word came out of her mouth, Bao Zhun scared her to tears. He didn't want the CEO's office to be damaged by heavy rain. "Go do your thing."
